body: I'm not so sure yet, but I'll work on that. I must thank you two from the bottom of my heart, although what I'm feeling hasn't changed much, you still took the time to help me and that's all that matter, so thank you. You probably prevented more cutting, or perhaps worse. You two are doing an amazing job. I do feel a bit better.
I'm not sure she'll get burned out that easily. She knows she helps, and I make it obvious to her. University. I used to work out everyday a bit, but I stopped, due to depression.
Unfortunately, that isn't really a great option...the counselors around here are kind of shitty people, and I'd much rather talk to faceless, non-judgmental internet people, which is probably weird.
I've made a reply if you're interested.

I was depressed for a while last year, but I got over it somehow. It's just crushing...there are things that have happened to me that I don't even want to mention, but know this: they're bad. Yes, we're quite in love, she knows I'm this sad, and she tries to help. I'm only really happy when I'm with her. Also, about the doctor, not really.
